name: VC Dimension of the Anchored Torsion Class
proof: Coordinates $x_1,x_2$ are shattered: concepts $h_1,h_3,h_4,h_5$ realize $00,01,10,11$, respectively. No three coordinates can be shattered because the entire class has only seven concepts, fewer than the eight distinct realizers required.
references: Direct calculation from the database-owned class definition and its characteristic computation.
